where: Dawnstead — the epilogue town in the first true daylight (and the post-game festival/Còr scenes there)
mood: The lullaby in full — the hometown theme finally meeting the sun, radiant, confident and a little teary.
core_styles: bright warm pulse-wave lead singing the hometown lullaby with confidence
gentle present groove with soft kick and brush
triumphant sunrise homecoming, joyful and warm with a tear in its eye

sections.name: Intro
sections.text: {a sunrise call: a rising harp sweep and a bright string chord as the sun clears the hills, the lead boldly announcing the hometown theme's first notes, into the theme}

sections.name: Main Theme
sections.text: {the hometown lullaby melody stated whole and confident in bright C major, harp flowing, bass walking with a warm stride}

sections.name: Main Theme Reprise
sections.text: {the same melody again with a soaring flute counter-melody weaving above and the strings fuller, like the whole town singing along}

sections.name: Bridge
sections.text: {contrast: the old wistful answer phrase reborn in F major, tender and grateful, softer groove, then a rising build of harp and strings back toward the theme}

sections.name: Main Theme Return
sections.text: {the lullaby returns in full radiant bloom with bells and counter-melody together; the last bar leads straight back into the theme, no ending}
styles: seamless loop back to the start of the theme
